purpose: Resolve previously held subtype ambiguity using denser direct visual review without auto-promotion.
reviewMethod: GPT direct visual re-review from original ~29.97 fps source material using newly generated 15 fps whole-source/lower-body evidence and targeted enlarged views. Any clearly asymmetric or one-foot support sequence rejects the clip from the pure two-foot STANDARD pool. No count is produced for rejected clips.

rows.reason: At 15 fps, the opening sequence already shows repeated unilateral support: one foot remains planted while the opposite foot lifts independently, with the pattern alternating across successive rope cycles. This is incompatible with synchronized two-foot basic bounce.

Dense 15 fps review plus enlarged frontal mirror view resolves the earlier distance/mirror ambiguity: the feet repeatedly remain staggered and alternate support rather than taking off and landing together. The clip is therefore not pure two-foot STANDARD.
